desc.zh: 从末尾逐字检查，推导反向字典树的停止条件。
desc.en: Scan from the newest letter and derive a reversed trie’s stopping rules.

complexity: O(S) build; O(min(t,L)) worst time per query; O(S+L) space

concepts.name: Reversed trie and suffix invariant
concepts.description: Share backward word paths and stop at terminal or missing edges.

concepts.name: Stateful bounded stream
concepts.description: Keep only the longest-word window across queries.
